I have only had one baby so far, so I'm not an expert by any means! But I did only put on 22 pounds and was back to my pre-pregnancy weight within a few weeks. Overall it sounds like you have a great approach.

One thing that helped me was to track my weight every week and ensure I wasn't putting on weight too fast at any point. Sure your weight gain won't be linear, but if you're trending high a few weeks in a row then you know it's time to start cutting back.

At lot of my friends didn't do that, and didn't realize just how much weight they put on until they had a doctor's appointment. And then at that point they all kind of gave up because they felt like they failed and the weight piled on even more.

I also told my husband about my desire to not put on tons of weight, and gave him permission so to speak to challenge anything I wanted to eat. One day I wanted some super gross fast food and he asked me respectfully if I really wanted it and if I would feel good after I ate it. The answer was obviously no and it helped snap me out of it and stay accountable. I really appreciated having someone non-hormonal around to keep me in check.

I'll also add that it's good to give yourself permission to back off on exercise as you get more pregnant. I worked out 5 days a week until about 35 weeks, cut it down to 3 days, and finally had to stop around 39 weeks. It's okay and doesn't mean you will get fat.

Good luck! Just the fact that you really don't want to get fat and are actively trying not to means you probably won't lol.

The issue: I open links in other tabs by middle-clicking, and then visit the tabs later. Developed this habit while traveling and had slow Internet, so this allowed me to open all the headlines I was interested in, and by the time I started reading the first one, it would have loaded fully.

A few weeks ago, the purple links stopped being there. I would open the links as I normally do, and the links would turn purple on the "Hot" page while I was doing so. However, when I reload? The links all turn back to white! (Some external links remain purple.)

Also, the "NN comments" on the "Hot" page never changes from white to purple, which I think is a bug and would eliminate the need for my below solution.

After a few days of opening some stories more than once and seeing my upvotes on comments indicating I've already read it (recovering from concussions, memory is spotty), I decided today to always vote on the story. Mostly, upvote since the ones that make it to "Hot" have already been essentially "vetted".

That way, while scanning the "Hot" page it will show that I had made an upvote, and I can skip re-reading those.

No other site behaves like this. I'm not an influencer either so I don't expect that I've been targeted. But who knows?
Anybody else having their "visited" links cleared, only at this site? Here's one "solution" for that...
